author.method: Direct scene-author subagent decision from original assembled fixture metadata and XML; no native run by author

basis: Two native preview attempts exceeded the 600 MiB watchdog before frames or physics steps.
Exact texture deduplication reduced116 definitions to41 but did not meet the memory budget.
Image allocation is rendering data and can remain separate from native collision/dynamics compilation.
scope: Source-preserving split preview. This does not approve new geometry, material design, physics parameters, camera changes, a source replacement, or final visual/physical acceptance.

allowed_changes: Remove asset/texture definitions from a derived preview XML only.
Detach texture references from material texture attributes and texture-layer references in the derived model, retaining their complete original definitions/bindings in the browser sidecar.
Retain the already authored camera and lightweight render-budget settings for any untextured geometry diagnostic.
must_preserve: all mesh files, mesh vertices/faces/normals/UVs and source mesh transforms
all bodies, inertial data, geoms, collision settings, contacts/exclusions, joints, constraints, actuators and source physics options
all material entries and non-texture material values
raw source XML, original images and all source asset hashes
evidence: derived XML hash and precise render-only edit manifest
canonical source-vs-derived comparison showing no non-render changes
original material-name/texture-role/image mapping and source material values
compiled geometry/body/joint inventory and transforms with stable name mapping
memory/watchdog result, zero-step count and explicit lack of physical-task acceptance
native_derived_model.native_image_label: Untextured native geometry diagnostic; not original-source appearance.

browser_material_translation.model: Classic source materials use a source-parameter Phong implementation; do not substitute invented PBR roughness/metalness values.
browser_material_translation.rgba: Use original material RGBA with resolved source geom/default-class RGBA override precedence. Texture RGB modulates that resolved color. Preserve source alpha/transparency.
browser_material_translation.specular: RGB=(source specular, source specular, source specular), with source/default scalar resolved from the source contract.
browser_material_translation.shininess: Phong exponent=128*source shininess, including source default when omitted.
browser_material_translation.emission: RGB=resolved source material/base RGB*source emission scalar; retain source/default emission. Do not add unrequested emissive lighting.
texture_mapping: Restore the ORIGINAL source texture binding per material, not a nearest-looking texture.
Preserve mesh UVs, primitive mapping, texrepeat, texuniform, texture type, cube face layout/orientation, flips and source dimensions.
Keep original source files/resolution; browser sharing of an identical decoded image is allowed without rewriting the image.
Record source image/color-space metadata and the explicit display pipeline. Do not apply artistic tone mapping, exposure compensation, saturation or recoloring.
browser_material_translation.reflectance: Preserve the source reflectance coefficient as metadata. Do not equate it with metallic, roughness or an invented environment map. If the source planar-reflection behavior is not implemented for this first browser preview, explicitly list that omission per affected material/geom and leave exact-render-equivalence unclaimed.
browser_material_translation.unsupported_source_features: Report any texture mapping, transparency, reflection or shader limitation. Do not silently replace materials; return material changes to Astra.

classic_diffuse_normalization.decision: In source-inspection Phong materials only, remove or compensate the extra1/PI factor in direct diffuse and indirect/ambient diffuse evaluation. Preserve stored source light/material coefficients, specular evaluation, texture/color-space pipeline, cameras and source physics.
classic_diffuse_normalization.reason: The extra1/PI normalization changes the source classic ambient/diffuse coefficient convention and is a concrete contributor to this dim result. Exact pixel equivalence with native OpenGL remains unproven.
classic_diffuse_normalization.implementation_scope: Source-inspection materials only; no other world renderer behavior changed.
classic_diffuse_normalization.remaining_limit: Three specular BRDF and per-light specular behavior remain a reported approximation pending comparison.

browser_scene_translation.geometry: Use native compiled mesh/body/geom transforms and original shape identity; no manual alignment corrections or collider-to-visual replacement.

visibility.other_geom_groups: No other groups authored; preserve renderer defaults.
visibility.reason: Match original visual-only rendering contract and suppress non-room EEF debug targets. Physics geometry remains compiled and unchanged.
visibility.overlays: No contact, joint-frame or site debug overlays.

cameras.angle_convention: Forward XY heading; eye/target are authoritative if renderer convention differs.
cameras.purpose: Clear southeast circulation corner across the island toward L-counter, source cabinet fronts, hood, fridge and domestic details. Eye height is a scene-inspection proxy, not a calibrated robot sensor.

cameras.angle_convention: Forward XY heading; eye/target are authoritative if renderer convention differs.
cameras.purpose: Elevated southeast overview of whole L-counter/island relationship and source circulation. Source has no ceiling; do not hide walls or fixtures.

browser_scene_translation.headlight: Retain source/default headlight state and values; identify them in the derived record.
browser_scene_translation.performance: Begin with one authored view at640x360 and no continuous simulation. Retain the approved resource watchdog; report failure rather than silently reducing source geometry or texture quality.

temporary_background.scope: First browser inspection only; source procedural gradient implementation remains pending.
temporary_background.display: Flat source rgb1 color [0.98,0.98,1.0] in the same recorded display color pipeline.
temporary_background.lighting_effect: Background only. Do not use it as an environment/reflection map, add ambient light, change exposure or tint the original materials.
temporary_background.required_disclosure: Source gradient skybox is temporarily shown as its flat upper color; lower gradient and horizon transition are not reproduced.
temporary_background.acceptance: This temporary presentation does not establish exact source-render equivalence or final visual approval. Preserve the original gradient definition for faithful implementation.

camera_clipping.rule: Use source resolved native znear*compiled model extent and zfar*compiled model extent from the exporter.
camera_clipping.source_zfar: Use resolved native source/default value from exporter; do not invent a replacement.
camera_clipping.evidence: Record resolved znear, zfar, compiled model extent and resulting near/far distances alongside each camera. Preserve existing eye/target/FOV.
camera_clipping.if_invalid: If clipping truncates useful source geometry or values are invalid, report exact evidence for authored revision; no silent override.

review_capture.scope: Static browser review only; original native preview budgets and physics settings unchanged.

acceptance_boundary: A kinematic browser scene can establish appearance, source-transform fidelity and inspectable articulation. Compilation or displayed joint motion does not establish settling, contact validity, gripper interaction, task execution or policy success. Physical runtime integration remains required.
current_stage_verdict: V2 source-inspection presentation is useful and acceptable for bounded review. Final high-fidelity visual, native-render equivalence and physical acceptance remain open.
